Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 13:23:00 -0400
Subject: Request: extra sandbox time for BrightBridge POC

Hi Naomi,

Quick note from our side — we hit an unexpected blocker while wiring the BrightBridge event connector into your SDK. The engineer leading the integration (and the team that owns the production API at our end) is out until next week, and we’ve also hit a backlog in our CI that’s stalling the connector build.

We’re mid-POC and the demo window is scheduled for the 25th; with the current freeze we won’t have a stable integration in time. Can we get a 2-week runway extension on the sandbox and a small top-up of credits for the extra API calls during troubleshooting? The trial tokens are already nearly exhausted due to repeated test runs while investigating.

I’ve attached a short error trace we’re seeing (error_trace.txt) and a bundle of logs (integration_logs.zip) that might help your engineers triage.

Appreciate any help — we want to keep the momentum.

Thanks,
Liam Chen
Senior Platform Engineer
BrightBridge Labs

Thanks Naomi — I dug into the logs Liam sent. Summary below:

- Root cause: intermittent 502s from BrightBridge’s staging event API during high-concurrency test runs; SDK-side retries are amplifying request volume and exhausting the sandbox quota.
- Short-term mitigation: reduce concurrency and enable per-request backoff to avoid retry storms.
- Required runway: to implement config changes, run integrated regression tests, and validate with two full demo runs we should plan for ~10 business days. Given calendar constraints, 2 weeks feels like a safe ask.

Estimate of extra usage: ~220k tokens (approx) or ~2,500 API calls over the troubleshooting period. If we can provision an extra $2,000 equivalent in sandbox credits, teams can iterate without hitting hard quota limits.

I’ve attached the error_trace.txt and a small filtered log set (included in integration_logs.zip) — highlights are marked in the log comments. If Naomi can get an approval path for a 2-week extension + $2k sandbox credits I’ll coordinate the low-level config change (we’ll also share a recommended backoff config to add to their deployment).

--
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
